player_prompt.intro:
Unacheza Countdown numbers game!
Lengo: Changanya nambari kwa kutumia +, -, *, / ili kufikia lengo.
Muundo wa hatua: [i j op] ambapo i,j ni viashiria na op ni operesheni.
Mfano: [0 2 *] inazidisha nambari kwenye nafasi 0 na nambari kwenye nafasi 2.
Mgawanyiko lazima uwe na matokeo ya nambari nzima pekee.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Nyuktago ok owinjore. Nyaka gibed mopogore kendo nyaka bed e kind 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Tiyo marach (pogo gi nono kata gima ok en kwan mar enteri)
